firm_data.firm_description: Robins Kaplan LLP is one of the nation’s leading trial law firms, known for delivering exceptional results in complex, high-stakes litigation. With a history of groundbreaking victories, we are trusted partners for clients navigating their most critical legal challenges.
notable_facts: Secured $6.5 billion settlement in historic Big Tobacco lawsuit.
Achieved extraordinary $5.5 billion settlement in Interchange Fee and Merchant Discount Litigation.
Achieved $42.4 million verdict in landmark patent infringement trial for inventor of innovative prelit artificial Christmas trees.
